videos.title: Transformers, the tech behind LLMs
videos.teaching_use: Best visual intuition: tokens to embeddings, through transformer layers, to next-token probabilities. Strong on embedding geometry, learned weights, output projection, softmax with temperature. Limitation: establishes overall architecture; detailed attention calculations come in the following chapter.

videos.title: Decoder-Only Transformers, ChatGPT's Specific Transformer, Clearly Explained
videos.teaching_use: Best focused explanation of the decoder-only architecture; patient step-by-step, small concrete examples; good for students who benefit from slower pacing on how pieces fit together.

videos.title: Let's build GPT: from scratch, in code, spelled out
videos.teaching_use: Turning understanding into implementation: builds a working GPT-style LM in PyTorch. Assumes Python/tensors/basic PyTorch (Karpathy recommends his makemore lessons first). Rick's strongest single recommendation for a technical audience. NOTE: exceeds the 10-15 min window — recommend as supplementary deep-dive, not the module's in-window pointer.

note: Rick's recommended progression for decoder-only transformers: visual understanding (3B1B) -> decoder architecture (StatQuest) -> working implementation (Karpathy). Multiple videos per module allowed per Rick. Map to modules: Q01 (next-token), Q16/Q17 (architectures/variations).
verification_note: All three verified live via oEmbed on 2026-10-10 (titles, channels, durations). None fits the 10-15 min contract window; Rick allows multiple videos per module. Decision for team: use as flagged supplementary deep-dives on Q01/Q16/Q17 with the in-window contract pointer still required separately, OR Rick can waive the window for these three.
